--- display dialog forms
on t(x)
    display dialog x
    display dialog x buttons {"A", "B"} default button 1
    display dialog x default answer "" with hidden answer
    display dialog x with title "T" with icon caution giving up after 5
    display dialog x buttons {"OK"} default button "OK" cancel button "OK" with icon stop
    display dialog x with icon note without hidden answer
    set r to display dialog "q" default answer "a"
    return {button returned of r, text returned of r, gave up of r}
end t
--- display dialog result inline
on t(x)
    set a to text returned of (display dialog x default answer "")
    set b to button returned of (display dialog x buttons {"Y", "N"})
    if button returned of (display dialog x) = "OK" then
        return a
    end if
    return b
end t
--- display alert and notification
on t(x)
    display alert x
    display alert x message "m" as critical buttons {"A", "B"} default button "B" giving up after 3
    display notification x
    display notification x with title "T" subtitle "S" sound name "Glass"
end t
--- choose commands
on t(x)
    set a to choose from list x
    set b to choose from list x with prompt "p" default items {1} with multiple selections allowed and empty selection allowed
    set c to choose file
    set d to choose file with prompt "p" of type {"txt"} default location (path to desktop) with invisibles without multiple selections allowed
    set e to choose folder with prompt "p"
    set f to choose file name with prompt "p" default name "n"
    set g to choose color default color {0, 0, 0}
    set h to choose application
    return {a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h}
end t
--- do shell script forms
on t(x)
    set a to do shell script x
    set b to do shell script "echo " & quoted form of x
    set c to do shell script x with administrator privileges
    set d to do shell script x user name "u" password "p" with administrator privileges
    set e to do shell script x without altering line endings
    do shell script "true"
    return {a, b, c, d, e, every paragraph of (do shell script x)}
end t
--- path to forms
on t()
    return {(path to desktop), (path to home folder), (path to me), (path to desktop from user domain), (path to library folder from user domain as text), (path to temporary items), (path to documents folder) as text, POSIX path of (path to me), (path to application "Finder"), (path to resource "a.txt"), (path to frontmost application as text)}
end t
--- file io
on t(p, x)
    set f to open for access file p with write permission
    set eof f to 0
    write x to f
    write x to f starting at eof
    write x to f as «class utf8»
    close access f
    set r to read file p
    set s to read file p as «class utf8» using delimiter linefeed
    set u to read f from 1 to 10
    set e to get eof f
    return {r, s, u, e}
end t
--- info and list
on t(p)
    set i to info for p
    set l to list folder p without invisibles
    set d to list disks
    return {size of i, name of i, folder of i, l, d, (system info), (system attribute "sysv")}
end t
--- misc additions
on t(x)
    beep
    beep 2
    delay 1
    delay 0.5
    say x
    say x using "Alex"
    set a to random number
    set b to random number from 1 to 10
    set c to round x
    set d to current date
    set e to time to GMT
    set f to ASCII number x
    set g to ASCII character 65
    set h to the clipboard
    set the clipboard to x
    set i to clipboard info
    set j to offset of "a" in x
    set k to summarize x in 1
    set l to localized string x
    return {a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, k, l}
end t
--- log and comments
on t(x)
    log x
    log "a" & x
    log {x, x}
    return x
end t
--- open location and url
on t(u)
    open location u
    open location u with error reporting
    return do shell script "curl " & quoted form of u
end t
--- run and launch
on t(n)
    launch application n
    activate application n
    tell application n
        activate
    end tell
    tell application n
        quit
    end tell
    tell application n
        launch
    end tell
    tell application n
        activate
        reopen
        quit saving no
    end tell
    return running of application n
end t
--- is running
on t()
    if application "Finder" is running then
        return 1
    end if
    if application "Safari" is not running then
        return 2
    end if
    if running of application "Finder" then
        return 3
    end if
    return {application "Finder" is running, not (application "Finder" is running)}
end t
--- tell to one liners
on t(n)
    tell application "Finder"
        set a to name of startup disk
    end tell
    tell application "Finder"
        return {a, name of desktop}
    end tell
end t
--- tell blocks nested apps
on t(n)
    tell application "Finder"
        set a to name of startup disk
        tell application "System Events"
            set b to name of process 1
        end tell
        set c to a & b
    end tell
    return c
end t
--- tell variable application
on t(n)
    tell application n
        activate
        set a to name
        set b to name
        set c to name
        set d to version
    end tell
    return {a, b, c, d}
end t
--- tell by id and path
on t()
    tell application id "com.apple.finder"
        set a to name
    end tell
    tell application "/System/Library/CoreServices/Finder.app"
        set b to name
    end tell
    return {a, b}
end t
--- using terms from
on t(n)
    using terms from application "Finder"
        tell application n
            set a to name of startup disk
        end tell
        return a
    end using terms from
end t
--- tell me and it
on t(x)
    tell me
        set a to name
    end tell
    tell x
        set b to length
        set c to length
        set d to item 1
        set e to length + 1
    end tell
    tell x
        set f to class
    end tell
    return {a, b, c, d, e, f}
end t
--- tell current application
on t()
    tell current application
        set a to name
        set b to path to desktop
    end tell
    return {a, b}
end t
--- system events keystrokes
on t(x)
    tell application "System Events"
        keystroke x
        keystroke "a" using command down
        keystroke "b" using {command down, shift down}
        key code 36
        key code 123 using {option down}
        click button 1 of window 1 of process x
        set frontmost of process x to true
        return name of process 1 whose frontmost = true
    end tell
end t
--- finder commands
on t(p)
    tell application "Finder"
        open p
        reveal p
        select p
        set a to selection
        set b to selection as alias list
        set c to POSIX path of (p as alias)
        set d to name of p
        set e to container of p
        set f to target of window 1 as alias
        empty trash
        eject disk "x"
        update p
        return {a, b, c, d, e, f, (sort every file of desktop by name)}
    end tell
end t
--- commands with direct parameters as specifiers
on t(p)
    tell application "Finder"
        open file "a" of desktop
        open every file of desktop
        duplicate file "a" of desktop to folder "b" of desktop
        move (every file of desktop whose name ends with ".tmp") to trash
        set name of file "a" of desktop to "c"
        set label index of every file of desktop to 0
        count every file of desktop
        exists file "a" of desktop
        name of every file of desktop
    end tell
end t
--- quit and cancel errors
on t(x)
    try
        display dialog x
    on error number -128
        return "cancelled"
    end try
    try
        error number -128
    on error number n
        if n = -128 then
            return 1
        end if
    end try
end t
--- string commands
on t(x)
    return {quoted form of x, POSIX path of x, x as POSIX file, id of x, character id 65, string id {72, 105}, text of x, contents of x, (do shell script "echo " & quoted form of POSIX path of x)}
end t
--- current application and me in commands
on t()
    return {(path to current application), (path to me), name of me, (path to me) as text, name of current application, id of me, version of current application}
end t
--- count and length in commands
on t(x)
    repeat with i from 1 to (count x)
        log item i of x
    end repeat
    repeat with i from 1 to (count x)
        log item i of x
    end repeat
    repeat with i from 1 to length of x
        log item i of x
    end repeat
    repeat with i from 1 to number of every item of x
        log item i of x
    end repeat
end t
--- set many kinds
on t(x)
    set a to 1
    set b to a
    set c to {a, b}
    set d to item 1 of c
    set item 1 of c to d
    set {e, f} to c
    copy c to g
    set h to c as text
    set i to missing value
    set j to length of x
    set k to length of x
    tell x
        set l to length
    end tell
    return {a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, k, l}
end t
--- copy forms
on t(x)
    copy x to a
    copy {1, 2} to b
    copy x to item 1 of b
    copy x & x to c
    copy item 1 of x to d
    copy a to {e, f}
    copy x to end of b
    copy x to g
    return {a, b, c, d, e, f, g}
end t
--- coercion given to a command
on t(x, y)
    do shell script (x as text)
    set a to (do shell script x) as text
    set b to do shell script x as text
    write (x as text) to y
    write x to (y as alias)
    display alert (x as text)
    set c to path to (x as text)
    log (x as text)
    return {a, b, c, (count (x as list))}
end t
--- raw event with raw labels
on t(v)
    tell v
        «event abcdefgh» 2 given «class rtyp»:text
        «event abcdefgh» 2 given «class kfil»:v, name:v
        «event abcdefgh» with «class flag» without «class nope»
    end tell
end t
--- name between bars with a backslash
on t()
    set |a\\b| to 1
    set |a b| to 2
    return {|a\\b|, |a b|}
end t
--- name that is the ending of an ordinal
on t(|st|, |nd|)
    set |rd| to |st| + |nd|
    set |th| to |rd| * 2
    return {|st|, |nd|, |rd|, |th|}
end t
--- name that is the first word of a keyword
on t(start, contained, |Begin|)
    display dialog start
    display dialog |start| with icon 1
    display dialog "a" & |Begin| with icon 1
    repeat with i from 1 to |contained| by 2
    end repeat
    lab of |start| with flag
    return {start, contained, |Begin|}
end t

on lab of x given flag:b
end lab
--- name that is the first word of a preposition
on t(y, info)
    repeat with |apart| from 1 to 2
    end repeat
    repeat with |aside| from apart to 3
    end repeat
    read |info| for 10
    return {|instead| of y, |out| of y, item |out| of y, out, info}
end t
--- name that joins the next word in a handler header
on lab2 from |contained| by y
    return y
end lab2

on |contained| by y
    return y
end |contained|

on lab3 of |contained| by y
    return y
end lab3

on |out| of x by y
    return x
end |out|

on adding folder items to |comes| after receiving x
    return {comes, x}
end adding folder items to

on t(info, x)
    lab2 from |contained| by 2
    lab4 of |info| for x
    |out| of x by 1
    try
        x
    on error |aside| from f
    end try
end t

on lab4 of a for b
end lab4
--- using terms from inside a block and with nothing in it
on t(x)
    if x then
        using terms from application "Finder"
            set m to 1
            set n to 2
        end using terms from
    end if
    using terms from application "Finder"
        using terms from application "Mail"
            set o to 3
        end using terms from
    end using terms from
end t

on u()
    using terms from application "Finder"
    end using terms from
end u
--- using terms from scripting additions
on t()
    using terms from scripting additions
        set m to 1
    end using terms from
end t
--- using terms from gives the words of a property of the target
on t(x)
    using terms from application "Finder"
        tell x
            return {startup disk, name of startup disk, desktop, home, trash, name of home}
        end tell
    end using terms from
end t

on u(x)
    using terms from application "Finder"
        tell x
            open startup disk
        end tell
    end using terms from
end u
--- property of the target given by its code
on t(x)
    tell x
        return {«property sdsk», name of «property sdsk», «class sdsk» of «property abcd», «class sdsk», «class abcd» of x}
    end tell
end t

on u(x)
    return «property sdsk»
end u
